about.title: A team, not just another office
about.lead: Afys Vilanova is an accountancy practice on Plaça de Soler i Gustems, in the centre of Vilanova. It works with individuals, freelancers and small businesses who want their paperwork in order and someone who answers when they call.
about.body1: What clients value most is clarity: knowing what has to be filed, when, and what happens when the rules change. Each person in the team has their own specialism, and queries do not sit waiting in a drawer.
about.body2: They have looked after the same businesses and families for years, which means they know the history and do not start from scratch every year.
about.pullquote: What clients say, again and again, is the same thing: they answer, and you can count on them.
